_about: v1.0.3: incoming student cohorts. Each key is the campaign year (World.Year) in which the listed NPC ids arrive at Halvard as first-years; before that they are inactive: their lore entry is empty (EJS gate), they are off the NPC roster, not regulars, not club members, not in the Connections graph, and the engine will not start a bond with them. Ids are first names, as in data/npcs.json. List them under 'Year 1:' in the lorebook's NPC Roster entry (uid 97). Then rebuild from tools/merge_lorebooks.py onward. 1.7.0: cohort 2 (owner-approved 2026-09-26, planning/DRAFT_cohort2_npcs.md) arrives in campaign Year 2; their entries come from source_original/npc_lore_cohort2_2026-09-26/.
